core_question: How do I keep a leather saddle from drying out and cracking?
answer_summary: Wipe down the saddle with a glycerin-based saddle soap to remove dirt and old grime, let it dry, then work in a leather conditioner or oil to keep the hide supple and crack-resistant.
persona: impatient and curt; writing in full careful sentences
